_references.selection: Ten large regular elliptical/cD stellar bodies with complete catalog inputs, selected after screening 21 candidate names. Not an exhaustive ten-largest ranking. Gas/radio extents and strongly distorted merging or ring systems are excluded. ESO-LV D26 outlines are conservative B-band isophotes, not D90 extrapolations.
